parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kor-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: >111 m (within Layer 4, 581 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 111 m to penetrate the resistive overburden/bedrock sequence and reach the lower-resistivity Layer 4, which is interpreted as the main water-bearing unit; ensure proper casing through the upper 111 m of higher-resistivity formations to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination.
